description_en: Deletes the configurations of a domain name for CDN acceleration in ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 调用本接口删除点播加速域名的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vod delete-vod-specific-config --domain-name www.example.com --config-id 23170000 --env online --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVodSpecificConfig

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD.
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en:
The environment from which you want to delete the configuration. Valid values:
- online: production environment
- gray: canary release environment
